opening.argument: The available evidence presents a discussion of cryptocurrency trading, not a concrete deceptive offer. The host describes the exchange as teaching him “all this crypto stuff,” while the guest expressly characterizes meme-coin trading as involving “much shorter durations and much higher risk.” His account includes personal risk-taking, including putting “80% of the money I had at the time” into a position, and he describes one trade as “just complete gambling.” That framing is inconsistent with a guaranteed-return pitch. The record also does not establish any required viewer payment or data transfer. The guest says, “I would never want to sell a course,” and the one-on-one contact link and mention of copy-trading, standing alone, do not establish deceptive solicitation.
